title: Pierce County Assessor-Treasurer Data Dictionary
text:
This document provides a comprehensive data dictionary for the Pierce County Assessor-Treasurer dataset used in the House Price Prediction project. The dataset contains detailed property assessment and appraisal information for over 400,000 properties in Pierce County, Washington.



Source: Pierce County Assessor-Treasurer Office
Region: Pierce County, Washington, USA
Total Properties: ~400,000 parcels
Features: 50+ attributes per property
Historical Coverage: 10+ years of sales transactions
Update Frequency: Annual (tax year basis)
Access: Public records (freely available)

title: Pierce County Assessor-Treasurer Data Dictionary
text:
3.1 Field Definitions









Field Name
Data Type
Length
Description




parcel_number
Text
10
Unique identifier. References tax_account. Links to improvement, land_attribute, and sale tables.


appraisal_account_type
Text
15
Classification of property for appraisal purposes. 15 types: Com Condo, Com Leasehold, Com Multi Unit, Commercial, Industrial, Mobile Home, Reference, Res Com Condo, Res Leasehold, Residential, Trended Invest. IMPORTANT FOR PRICE PREDICTION: Residential vs Commercial distinction.


business_name
Text
50
Main business name on the parcel, or space number for mobile/manufactured home in a park. Often blank for residential.


value_area_id
Text
10
Physical inspection cycle identifier (PI1 to PI6). Indicates when property was last physically inspected. Used to assess appraisal recency.


land_economic_area
Text
30
Also known as LEA. Ties parcels to land valuation models. For Commercial: identifies land use model by PI year. For Residential: location code identifying appraisal area, sector, subsector. For Res Com Condos: relates to account land value. KEY LOCATION FEATURE.


buildings
Integer

Number of building improvements located on the parcel. Critical feature: 0 = vacant land, 1+ = improved property.


group_account_number
Text
30
For group accounts: identifies all parcels constituting one economic unit (contiguous assessment). For condominiums: identifies all units in project.


land_gross_acres
Decimal
15.4
Total acres of economic unit (may include multiple parcels). Used for large properties and commercial analysis.


land_net_acres
Decimal
15.4
Net acreage of individual parcel only. PRIMARY LAND SIZE METRIC for single-parcel properties. Range: 0.01 to 100+ acres.


land_gross_square_feet
Decimal
15.4
Total square feet of economic unit. Gross measure including non-usable areas.


land_net_square_feet
Decimal
15.4
Net square feet of individual parcel. CRITICAL FEATURE for price prediction. Typical range: 2,000 to 50,000 sq ft for residential.


land_gross_front_feet
Decimal
15.4
For commercial: front feet facing arterial street. For residential: front feet facing address street. For waterfront: effective waterfront length. Affects commercial value significantly.


land_width
Integer

Residential use only. Equal to net effective waterfront front feet. Used for waterfront properties.


land_depth
Integer

Residential use only. Net effective depth from bulkhead to inland property line. Used for waterfront properties. Measured from top of bank.


submerged_area_square_feet
Integer

Area of parcel that is submerged. Not included in gross or net square feet. Indicates waterfront property.


appraisal_date
Date

Most recent date appraiser physically observed property and/or made record changes. DATA RECENCY INDICATOR: Older dates suggest stale appraisals. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.


waterfront_type
Text
30
Describes type of waterfront property adjoins or has legal access to. Values: Lake, Puget Sound, River, Creek, None, etc. SIGNIFICANT PRICE PREMIUM FEATURE.


view_quality
Text
30
Market appeal of view from dwelling/property. Values: None, Fair, Good, Excellent. QUALITATIVE PRICE DRIVER.


utility_electric
Text
30
Identifies if electric power is installed, available, or not available on property. Essential utility. Values: Available, Not Available, Installed.


utility_sewer
Text
30
Sewer/septic system availability. Values: Available, Not Available, Septic system, Shared septic. Critical for residential value.


utility_water
Text
30
Water availability. Values: Available, Not Available, Well water, City water.


street_type
Text
30
Identifies if access street is paved or unpaved. Affects property access and value. Blank for reference parcels or mobile homes.


latitude
Decimal
10.5
Latitude of parcel centroid (decimal degrees). GEOGRAPHIC FEATURE for spatial analysis. Missing for ~5-10% (building-only, mineral rights, reference parcels). Range: 47.0 to 47.9 for Pierce County.


longitude
Decimal
10.5
Longitude of parcel centroid (decimal degrees). GEOGRAPHIC FEATURE. Range: -122.0 to -121.0 for Pierce County.

Field Name

5.1 Field Definitions









Field Name
Data Type
Length
Description




parcel_number
Text
10
Parcel identifier.


building_id
Text
5
Building identifier on parcel.


builtas_number
Integer

Sequential number identifying each built-as record. Largest built-as is number 1. Indicates primary vs. additions.


builtas_id
Integer

Numeric code for construction purpose/style. Links to Marshall and Swift cost tables. Used in appraisal valuation.


builtas_description
Text
255
Text description of construction purpose/style. Examples: “1 Story Residential”, “2 Story Residential with Basement”, “Office Building”, “Warehouse”.


builtas_square_feet
Integer

Square feet for this specific built-as type. Sum equals building square_feet.


hvac
Integer

Code for predominant heating source. Values: 1=Forced Air, 2=Baseboard, 3=Steam, 4=Radiant, etc. BUILDING SYSTEMS FEATURE.


hvac_description
Text
30
Text description of heating system. Examples: Forced Air Gas, Electric Baseboard, Steam Boiler, Radiant Heat. Affects operating costs and comfort (price component).


exterior
Text
25
Predominant exterior material on residential buildings. Values: Wood Siding, Vinyl, Brick, Stucco, Cement Board, Log, Metal. CONDITION/QUALITY FEATURE.


interior
Text
15
Predominant interior wall material (collected for residential and mobile homes only). Values: Drywall/Sheetrock, Paneling, Plaster. Indicates age/renovation status.


stories
Decimal
13.2
Number of floors above grade. Does not include attic or basement. IMPORTANT: 1 story vs 2 story is price differentiator. Values: 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, etc.


story_height
Integer

Building ceiling height in feet for first floor. Indicates space quality. Commercial: average of all floors. Residential: majority floor height. Typical: 8-10 feet residential, 12-14 feet commercial.


sprinkler_square_feet
Integer

Total square footage covered by sprinkler system. Zero if no sprinklers. Fire safety feature affecting commercial valuation.


roof_cover
Text
20
Roofing material. Values: Composition Shingles, Wood Shake, Concrete Tile, Slate, Metal, Rubber/EPDM. CONDITION/DURABILITY FEATURE: Newer materials (asphalt shingles 20-year, metal 40+ year) affect replacement cost.


bedrooms
Integer

Number of bedrooms in residential property. PRIMARY FEATURE for residential valuation. Typical: 2-4 bedrooms. Collected for informational purposes.


bathrooms
Decimal
7.2
Number of bathrooms (decimal format). PRIMARY FEATURE for residential valuation. Calculation: Full bath=1.0, 3/4 bath=0.75, 1/2 bath=0.5, 1/4 bath=0.25. Examples: 2.5 = 2 full + 1 half bath. Range: 0.5 to 5.0+.


units
Integer

Number of separate units within building. 1 = single-family, 2 = duplex, 3+ = multi-unit. PROPERTY TYPE INDICATOR. Affects valuation approach (per-unit vs. whole building).


class_code
Text
20
Cost class for commercial buildings. Codes for framing (wood, steel, concrete), walls, floors, roof, fireproofing. Affects construction cost estimates.


class_description
Text
50
Text description of building class. Used primarily for commercial valuation.


year_built
Integer

Year building was constructed (actual). Based on permit or historical records. CRITICAL AGE FEATURE for depreciation. Format: YYYY (e.g., 1985, 2010, 2023).


year_remodeled
Integer

Year major improvements/renovations completed. Extends building life expectancy. Impacts depreciation calculation. Zero if no remodel recorded.


adjusted_year_built
Integer

If > year_built: indicates major improvements made beyond normal maintenance (roof, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, structural). Reduces effective age. Formula: physical_age = current_year - adjusted_year_built. CONDITION INDICATOR.


physical_age
Integer

Calculated field: current_year - adjusted_year_built. Represents effective age for depreciation. Critical for price prediction. Typical: 0-80+ years.


builtas_length
Integer

Length of mobile/manufactured home in feet. Used for mobile home valuation. Typical: 50-80 feet.


builtas_width
Integer

Width of mobile/manufactured home in feet. Typical: 12-16 feet.


mobile_home_model
Text
50
Model name/number of mobile home. Used for market comparables research.

text:
8.1 Field Definitions









Field Name
Data Type
Length
Description




etn
Text
11
Excise Tax Number. Unique transaction ID issued by county auditor when deed recorded. Format: 11-character recording number. Links to county deed recording. TRANSACTION IDENTIFIER.


parcel_count
Integer

Number of parcels involved in single transaction. Usually 1, can be >1 for bulk sales.


parcel_number
Text
10
Parcel number(s) involved in sale. Links to tax_account and appraisal_account. May be multiple parcels per transaction.


sale_date
Date

Date legal document (deed) was executed (YYYY-MM-DD). TRANSACTION TIMING FEATURE. Used to filter recent market data and analyze trends. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.


sale_price
Decimal
15.2
Dollar amount recorded on ETN. PRIMARY PREDICTION TARGET VARIABLE or feature for model training. Range: $10,000 to $10,000,000+ for Pierce County.


deed_type
Text
40
Type of document conveying interest/legal title. Values: Warranty Deed, Quit Claim, Grant Deed, Trustee’s Deed, etc. Indicates transaction formality.


grantor
Text
80
Seller: Individual(s) or company conveying ownership/interest in property. May be truncated for multi-party transactions.


grantee
Text
80
Buyer: Individual(s) or company purchasing ownership/interest in property.


valid_invalid
Text
7
CRITICAL FOR MODEL TRAINING: Codes validity of sale for appraisal purposes. Values: “Valid” (open market, unrelated parties, no pressure), “Invalid” (family transfer, estate sale, forced sale, < 1% interest, etc.). IMPORTANT: Filter to “Valid” only for accurate models. Approximately 70-80% of recorded sales are “Valid”.


confirmed_unconfirmed
Text
11
Whether property characteristics and transaction circumstances verified by assessor staff. Values: “Confirmed” (staff verified), “Unconfirmed” (not verified). Indicates data confidence level.


exclude_reason
Text
30
If invalid: reason for exclusion from appraisal sales studies. Examples: “Family different last names”, “Estate sale”, “Forced Sale Trans in Lieu Fcl”, “Improved after sale”, “1% Interest”, “Non-arms length”. Helps identify problematic transactions.


improved_vacant
Text
8
Property improvement status at sale. Values: “Improved” (has building value), “Vacant” (vacant land, no building). Distinguishes between land and improved property sales.


appraisal_account_type
Text
15
Property classification at time of sale. Same values as appraisal_account.appraisal_account_type. Indicates if residential, commercial, etc.

title: Pierce County Assessor-Treasurer Data Dictionary
text:
8.2 Critical Notes for Price Prediction

Filter for Valid Sales Only: Remove ~20-30% marked “Invalid”
Use Recent Data: Last 5-10 years most relevant to current market
Adjust for Inflation: Historical prices should be inflation-adjusted
Consider Seasonality: Sales patterns vary by season
Data Lag: Sales recorded 1-2 weeks after closing

text:
13.1 Primary Features (Highest Predictive Power)
From Appraisal Account:
- total_market_value_current_year (TARGET for supervised learning)
- land_net_square_feet (primary land size)
- latitude, longitude (location)
- waterfront_type (qualitative location)
- view_quality (qualitative location)

From Improvement:
- buildings (count of improvements)
- property_type (categorical: Residential, Commercial, etc.)
- neighborhood (strong price predictor)
- square_feet (building size)

From Improvement Built-As:
- year_built, adjusted_year_built (age)
- physical_age (calculated age)
- bedrooms, bathrooms (residential features)
- stories (building size indicator)
- exterior, roof_cover (condition)

From Sale:
- sale_price (actual market prices)
- sale_date (temporal feature)
- valid_invalid (filter for quality sales)

From Land Attribute:
- attribute, attribute_description (special features)

title: Pierce County Assessor-Treasurer Data Dictionary
text:
13.3 Derived/Engineered Features
Create from raw data:
- price_per_sqft = total_market_value / land_net_square_feet
- price_per_buildsqft = total_market_value / building_square_feet
- land_value_ratio = land_value / total_market_value
- improvement_value_ratio = improvement_value / total_market_value
- effective_age = adjusted_year_built - current_year
- property_age_category = binned(adjusted_year_built)
- is_waterfront = (waterfront_type != "None")
- has_excellent_view = (view_quality == "Excellent")
- improvement_premium = improvement_value - baseline_cost

15.2 Update Schedule

Frequency: Annual (tax year basis)

2. Comprehensive Coverage - Includes ALL property types in the county - Complete historical records (10+ years of sales) - Detailed building-level specifications
3. Rich Feature Set - 50+ features per property - Multiple data sources (tax system + appraisal system) - Both current and historical valuations
4. Regular Updates - Annual appraisal cycles (PI1-PI6 rotating) - Continuous sale transaction recording - Physical inspection dates documented
5. Geospatial Data - Latitude/Longitude coordinates for geographic analysis - Neighborhood/area codes for spatial grouping - Waterfront and location-based attributes



1. Missing Values - Latitude/Longitude: Not available for ~5-10% of parcels - Reason: Building-only, mineral rights, reference parcels - Taxpayer Information: Restricted by privacy law - Some optional fields may be sparsely populated

3. Historical Changes - Property characteristics may change over time (segregation, mergers, improvements) - Appraisal dates vary (property inspection cycle: PI1-PI6) - Classification changes (e.g., residential to commercial conversion)
4. Valid Sales Filtering - ~20-30% of recorded sales flagged as “Invalid” for appraisal purposes - Invalid reasons: Family transfers, estate sales, forced sales, pre-1031 exchanges - Requires filtering for market analysis
5. Outliers & Anomalies - Reference parcels (non-taxable, minimal value) - Mineral rights and leasehold improvements - Extreme value outliers (multi-million dollar properties) - Development parcels (no building yet)
